abstract: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically. business_implications_zh: 生成式推荐中语义ID的改进可直接体现在推荐命中率上，最高可带来+52% Hit@10的提升。
图构建与递归划分可分别配置，便于推荐系统团队将两类优化组合并系统评估，从而迭代验证不同策略。
contributions_zh: 将语义ID构建重新定义为递归聚类/层次图划分问题，而非单纯的表示学习。
提出统一框架GrIS，将RQ-VAE与RQ-KMeans视为空图特例，揭示图构建和递归划分算法两个可独立配置的设计轴。
提出两种实例化：RecDMoN（可微图池化的层次分配）与RQ-GAE（图感知物品表示加图重构目标）。
在多个真实数据集上相对CF感知SOTA一致提升，最高+52% Hit@10。

datasets: 多个真实世界数据集（原文摘要未列具体名称）
findings_zh: GrIS在多个真实世界数据集上相较CF感知SOTA一致提升，最高达+52% Hit@10。
RQ-VAE与RQ-KMeans被恢复为空图特例，显示纯内容量化只是设计空间中的一个角落。
图构建与递归划分作为独立可配置组件，使两类改进能够组合并系统评估。

deep_reading.method_zh: GrIS将物品与交互构建为图：节点含语义内容，边含协同信号，然后通过层次化图划分分配语义ID。框架包含两个显式可配置组件：图构建与递归划分算法；RQ-VAE/RQ-KMeans是空图情形下的特例。实例化包括RecDMoN（可微图池化）和RQ-GAE（扩展RQ-VAE，加入图感知物品表示与图重构目标）。
deep_reading.problem_zh: 现有语义ID构建被当作表示学习问题（将物品编码到量化潜在空间并读出代码），本文认为其本质是递归聚类问题：应以节点承载语义内容、边承载协同信号的图为对象，将语义ID分配转化为层次化图划分。

summary_zh: 该论文提出图感知语义ID（GrIS）框架，通过图神经网络与生成式推荐方法平衡语义与协同信号，提升推荐性能。
title: Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)
